description: The JSON document a Studio (visual editor) paywall is made of, with its status and version, plus the reference to the document model. Read this before save_paywall_doc, and edit the document you got rather than writing one from scratch — keep node ids, change only what was asked. Prices are never typed: use {{ products.<slot>.price }} and the other product variables.
name: get_paywall_doc
title: Get a Studio paywall's document
